quick-edit-damage.title: Damage tuning
quick-edit-damage.body: Damage values affect how much HP is removed per hit. Most BAPBAP abilities expect a balanced 60–180 range; values above 250 typically one-shot.
quick-edit-damage.example: Try 110 for moderate combat, 220 for heavy hitters.

quick-edit-cooldown.title: Cooldown values
quick-edit-cooldown.body: Cooldown is the seconds between casts. Short cooldowns feel more responsive but can break encounter pacing.
quick-edit-cooldown.example: 3–6 seconds reads as snappy, 10+ feels like a deliberate choice.

quick-edit-duration.title: Effect duration
quick-edit-duration.body: How long a status effect persists on a target, in seconds.
quick-edit-duration.example: Try 1.5 for tap-to-disrupt effects, 6+ for long-burn DOTs.

quick-edit-radius.title: Effect radius
quick-edit-radius.body: Area-of-effect radius in world units. Larger values hit more enemies but trivialise crowd control.

quick-edit-cost.title: Resource cost
quick-edit-cost.body: Cost charged when this ability is used. Higher cost forces players to budget their casts.
quick-edit-cost.example: Use 0 for basic kit slots, 30–50 for ultimates.

override-map.title: Override map
override-map.body: The Override Map shows every value you've changed on this file as a flat JSON object. Edit JSON directly here for advanced overrides.

file-picker.title: Change file
file-picker.body: Click to switch to another runtime document without leaving the editor. Your unsaved drafts on the current file are preserved.
file-picker.example: Use Ctrl+F to focus the file search inside the picker.

effect-add.title: Add effect
effect-add.body: Browse the indexed catalog of known PassiveSO / StatusEffect blocks. Type to filter; pick to add to this slot.
effect-add.example: Search 'fire' returns Firewave Burn, Firewave, Style Factor Pin.

effect-remove.title: Remove effect
effect-remove.body: Removes this effect from the configuration. The block is preserved in the override map and can be restored via Undo.
effect-remove.example: Cmd+Z (or Ctrl+Z) reverts an accidental removal.

save-action.title: Save changes
save-action.body: Writes the current overrides to disk. A timestamped backup is created automatically before each save.
save-action.example: Restart Beat Saber after save to apply runtime changes.

reset-all.title: Reset all values
reset-all.body: Clears every override on this file, returning every value to the standard runtime data. This action is undoable.
reset-all.example: Use sparingly — bulk resets land in the history stack.

advanced-section.title: Behavior and advanced
advanced-section.body: Less commonly tweaked fields live here. Includes raw paths, hidden defaults, and inferred deeper edits.
advanced-section.example: Open this section only when quick edit doesn't expose what you need.

card-art.title: Card art
card-art.body: The icon shown in-game. Pick from sprite atlases or upload custom PNGs in the Custom builder.
card-art.example: 256×256 PNGs render best on standard cards.

match-rules-zone.title: Zone rules
match-rules-zone.body: Zone rules govern arena boundaries, spawn radii, and elimination geometry.
match-rules-zone.example: Increase spawn radius to spread players out at game start.

match-rules-bots.title: Bot behavior
match-rules-bots.body: Bot density and difficulty controls. High counts can stress the runtime; verify performance before saving.
match-rules-bots.example: 8–12 bots per match keep encounters lively without lag.

swap-source-pool.title: Source pool
swap-source-pool.body: The Swap source pool lists every ability you can swap into this slot, grouped by recommended/family/all.
swap-source-pool.example: Recommended sources match the original slot's role and cost.
